uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1722-2034-3583-6578.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6578.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

206-240-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

579-4824-6723.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-1137-2018.description:
Activate Rith's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Rith's Attendant dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Rith's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Rith's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Rith's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Rith's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

2034-4289-4885-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

341-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

654-2893-3875-5455.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Tireless Provisioner and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

539-4693-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1445-2267-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-6797.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

222-527-2511-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2511-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1168-1651-2573-5542-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-2573-5542-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-2573-5542-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Delney, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1563-1753-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2043-3129-5231-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing six Cats, adding six {R}.
Repeat.
2043-3129-5231-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

801-5553-5626-5687.notablePrerequisites: One of Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
801-5553-5626-5687.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Skittering Precursor trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

864-4872-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
864-4872-5626.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
864-4872-5626.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 3 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Eternal Witness, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

751-3487-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Shrieking Drake
751-3487-5674.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Aetherstorm Roc trigger.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1061-1339-4189.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator and Jalira do not have summoning sickness.
You have no other nonlegendary creatures in your library.
1061-1339-4189.description:
During your draw step, The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Jalira by paying {2}{U}, tapping it and sacrificing the Insect, causing you to reveal Timestream Navigator and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

2101-3525-3883.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Dakra Mystic.
Dakra Mystic does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
2101-3525-3883.description:
Activate Dakra Mystic by paying {U} and tapping it, causing each player to revel the top card of their library, then causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Dakra Mystic.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

438-628-1123-3496.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Dread Slaver.
438-628-1123-3496.description:
Kill Dread Slaver.
When Dread Slaver dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Flayer of the Hatebound triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

57-1636-4813.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-1636-4813.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Famished Foragers that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Famished Foragers trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1030-1110-2034-4831.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1110-2034-4831.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cacophodon, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Cacophodon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cacophodon enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing damage equal to Cacophodon's power to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

1734-2506-5147.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, choosing not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter with haste.
The Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
The nontoken Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
The Fiend Hunter token leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

2104-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
2104-3976.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Temporal Manipulation and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Temporal Manipulation without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

527-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Selvala.
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power three or greater.
527-4222.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

364-614-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
364-614-1987.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Nucklavee and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
